{"people":[{"name":"Maya","role":"head of digital","side":"customer"},{"name":"Greg","role":"controller","side":"customer"},{"name":"Studio managers","role":"front-desk staff group","side":"customer"},{"name":"Tobi","role":"solutions engineer","side":"us"},{"name":"Rep (unnamed)","role":"account executive","side":"us"},{"name":"Partner (unnamed)","role":"integration partner","side":"other"},{"name":"Global Payments","role":"incumbent payments provider","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Global Payments"],
"incumbent":"Global Payments, through the studio software",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"They report member churn to the board every quarter","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep, relaying the customer","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Customer reports churn to its board quarterly; the trigger was board-level pressure."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"it had ticked up two quarters running","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep, relaying the customer","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Churn rose two straight quarters before the evaluation began."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"somebody finally split it into people who cancelled and people whose card just failed","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep, relaying the customer","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Churn was split by cause, revealing a failed-card bucket."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"The second bucket was a lot bigger than anyone expected.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Failed-card churn surprised the customer; the core trigger."},
{"id":"E5","turn":2,"excerpt":"members who never meant to leave","label":"quote","speaker":"Maya (head of digital)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer's own framing of failed-card churn; reusable language."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"I want to say a third of the churn?","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep unsure of the share; claims it is in the board deck."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"She ran the evaluation, she was in every meeting","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's basis for naming Maya as the decider."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"She said it was her call.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Maya (head of digital), relayed by the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Maya's self-assessment of decision authority, unverified and later contradicted."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Global Payments was already in there, through the studio software.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Incumbent is embedded through the studio software."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"they came back with a rate review and a new terminal bundle for the front desks, on a longer contract","label":"fact","speaker":"Maya (head of digital), relayed by the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Global's counteroffer, reported secondhand; rep did not see it."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"My read is they were rattled, but that's my read, not hers.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep's own guess about the incumbent's reaction; explicitly not the customer's view."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"Suddenly everything was hardware.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Customer's questions shifted to hardware after the incumbent meeting."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"Before that meeting it was all failed payments and retries.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Pre-meeting focus was failed payments; our core pitch matched this."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Greg asked about termination fees twice.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","competitor"],"note":"Controller focused on exit costs, signaling a cost and contract concern."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"took an export of one month of their failed renewals","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Tobi used the customer's own failed-renewal data in the demo."},
{"id":"E16","turn":14,"excerpt":"Greg hadn't said a word in two meetings, and he asked for the spreadsheet.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","message"],"note":"Greg's first engagement came from the data, not the pitch."},
{"id":"E17","turn":14,"excerpt":"I opened with the global slide. They have studios in the US and a handful in Canada.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Global-scale opener; customer footprint is small and regional."},
{"id":"E18","turn":14,"excerpt":"is that the readers?","label":"quote","speaker":"Maya (head of digital)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Maya heard unified commerce as hardware, not software."},
{"id":"E19","turn":14,"excerpt":"unified commerce","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our term; did not land with the customer."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"Before that I honestly thought we were there to keep the incumbent honest.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's earlier read that they were a benchmark, not a true contender."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"The paper had gone to Greg and it sat with him for two weeks.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Proposal sat with Greg for two weeks before movement."},
{"id":"E22","turn":16,"excerpt":"four days later it was signed","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Signature followed the data session by four days."},
{"id":"E23","turn":18,"excerpt":"His signature's on it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Greg signed; conflicts with Maya as sole decider."},
{"id":"E24","turn":20,"excerpt":"Maya chose us. Greg decided whether anybody got chosen.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's revised decider claim after pushback; split authority."},
{"id":"E25","turn":22,"excerpt":"They asked to see our reader working inside their studio management software.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Front-desk integration was requested and not shown live."},
{"id":"E26","turn":22,"excerpt":"We couldn't show that live. It runs through a partner integration","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Demo gap: the front-desk flow depended on a partner integration."},
{"id":"E27","turn":22,"excerpt":"It nearly cost us.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's assessment of the demo gap's deal risk."},
{"id":"E28","turn":22,"excerpt":"the studio managers will revolt","label":"quote","speaker":"Maya (head of digital)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Customer's stated objection to two-screen front-desk workflow."},
{"id":"E29","turn":24,"excerpt":"They saw the partner's demo. Not in their own setup.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer never saw the product in its own environment before signing."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"what they signed is memberships. Online billing went first.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Signed scope covers only online membership billing."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"The studios are phase two.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Studio front desk is deferred to a second phase."},
{"id":"E32","turn":26,"excerpt":"Still Global.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","competitor"],"note":"Front-desk payments remain with the incumbent."},
{"id":"E33","turn":28,"excerpt":"Not yet. It depends on the partner piece.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No date for phase two; tied to partner work."},
{"id":"E34","turn":14,"excerpt":"The reaction was failed payment recovery.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"The pitch element that drew a reaction from the customer."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E8","E23","E24"],"what":"Rep first says Maya decided, then Greg's signature is on the contract, then splits the decision between Maya and Greg."},
{"evidence":["E22","E30","E32"],"what":"Rep describes the deal as signed, but only online membership billing was signed; front-desk payments remain with Global."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":13,"what":"Answered the reaction side; the silence side was left as one unclear word ('Silence.') with no named pitch element."},
{"question":"Then who made the final call?","turn":19,"what":"Repeated Maya after the earlier answer, then conceded and split the decision with Greg only after pushback."},
{"question":"What exact words did they—","turn":29,"what":"Deflected the customer-language question by moving it to Slack, citing a customer call."}
],
"skipped":["language"],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"is that the readers?","ours":"unified commerce","evidence":["E18","E19"]},
{"theirs":"failed payments and retries","ours":"failed payment recovery","evidence":["E13","E34"]},
{"theirs":"members who never meant to leave","ours":"failed-card churn analysis (rep's framing)","evidence":["E3","E5"]},
{"theirs":"the studio managers will revolt","ours":"our reader working inside their studio management software","evidence":["E25","E28"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E22","E23"],"what":"Deal signed four days after the data session; Greg's signature is on the contract."},
{"evidence":["E30","E31","E33"],"what":"Partial win: only membership online billing signed; studio phase two has no date and depends on the partner."},
{"evidence":["E32","E26"],"what":"Front-desk payments still with Global Payments; the live front-desk demo could not be shown."}
]}
